Capability: Defines the workspace shell's stages, views, per-stage view memory, section homes, stage tabs, inspector and drawer rules, and the ordered list of workspace sections.
Notes: Pure presentation rules with no model reads or writes; section list comments carry historical rationale.

Capability: Top toolbar showing the project name and edited marker, undo and redo, run and stop, view switch, inspector and agent toggles, appearance choice and an issue count.
Notes: Agent toggle is rendered disabled with a reason.

Capability: Lets the user navigate between Model, Loads, Results and Review stages and the library, rules and issues pages via a stage rail and a per-stage table tab strip with a collapsible drawer.
Notes: Navigation only; calls the session's active-section setter.

Capability: Bottom status bar showing status chips, the current selection, display units, and toggles for the issues and audit drawers.
Right-hand agent strip reserved for a future agent column; its single control is disabled with an explanatory reason.
Notes: Placeholder only; no live agent binding.

Capability: Keeps disabled controls focusable and exposes their disabled reason to assistive technology through a dismissible tooltip.
Notes: Shared by shell parts and some rule-pack and rule-check controls outside this area.

Capability: Defines the File, Edit, View, Insert and Analyze menu model and dispatches menu command ids from the in-page menu bar or the native desktop menu to session actions.
Notes: Native menu state is synchronized through a service outside this area.

Capability: Persists per-user UI preferences (theme, density, split and drawer sizes) in browser storage with bounds, versioning and fallback, and supports keyboard resizing of splitters and drawers.
Measures shell chrome height and reserves the remaining space for the 3D canvas without feedback from the canvas itself.
Keeps inactive expensive workspace sections mounted but dormant, skipping re-render until they become active or the session generation changes.
Holds and orchestrates the desktop workspace session state (model, selection, results, operations, project, chrome) and hands slices to shell components through a context.
Notes: Client-side state orchestration in one very large hook; stale-response guards use generation and revision refs. Also records a journey-event log in chrome state.

Capability: Lets the user create a sample or blank project, list, open and save local projects through the local project store.
Checks returned and reopened project data: recomputes model and envelope hashes against stored claims, accepts only the supported persisted normalization, and guards stale persistence observations.
Notes: Missing legacy hash claims are not treated as verified.

Capability: Lets the user undo and redo applied session model edits using model checkpoints.
Notes: Session-only history; not persisted.

Capability: Maintains an ordered multi-entity selection with modifier, range and box selection, focus and pruning, plus hide, isolate and clear-visibility of entities.
Builds a cached index of model entities with 3D bounds, spatial chunks and section bindings, and checks converted section envelopes for consistency.
Notes: Consumed by the model tree, viewport and session.

Capability: Publishes a versioned UI diagnostics snapshot (renderer info, owned resource counts, model assignment timing, projection results) on a page global for measurement harnesses.
Notes: Primarily an instrumentation surface for benchmark tooling.

Capability: Maps registered software status and evidence tokens to display labels with their authority domain, and renders unregistered status values readably without inventing labels.
Notes: Includes a display-only fallback for an unsolved solver status.

Capability: Provides virtualized scrolling lists and single or multi target pickers for large entity sets.
Notes: Shared component used by many authoring panels outside this area.

Capability: Provides a compact accessible select control with scoped identity used by inspector, viewport and authoring forms.
Notes: Shared component.

Capability: Lets the user edit a spreadsheet-like engineering table with keyboard cell navigation, sorting by unit-aware quantity, enum completion and per-cell validation.
Defines node, material and section table columns and converts table cell edits into structured model operation intents.
Model tree that lists project entities hierarchically with filtering, keyboard navigation, selection sync and visibility state.
Lets the user switch the tree to a grid layout and bulk-edit nodes, materials and sections in tables, then queue the resulting draft changes as operation intents.
Property inspector showing the selected entity's properties with dual-unit display, provenance, required flags, unit catalog status and embedded support, temperature, wind and section forms.
Notes: Embeds forms owned by other feature folders.

Capability: Lets the user draft inspector edit intents: change a property with unit and rationale, create materials, sections, components or supports, delete nodes, pipes or supports, and preview validation.
Notes: Some create panels (material, section, component, support) have no test referencing their test ids directly.

Capability: Lets the user validate and apply queued structured operations one at a time, see engine and unit-policy status, and review operations applied this session.
Queues, validates and applies operation batches and frozen route-draft reviews against the current model.
Notes: Batch and draft UIs live outside this area.

Capability: Operation review ledger listing queued intents and proposal records, with clear-queue and a downloadable JSON ledger export.
Notes: Shown inside a collapsible review-details drawer; export packet embeds hard-coded governance identifiers.

Capability: Operation diff preview showing before and after values with units for queued intents and proposals, with a downloadable JSON diff export and unit disclosure.
Notes: Shown inside the review-details drawer; export packet embeds hard-coded governance identifiers.

Capability: Editor contract review listing material, component and rule-pack reference editors, field readiness, warnings and unit contract, with a downloadable JSON review export.
Notes: Rule-pack reference is a fixed placeholder; export packet embeds hard-coded governance identifiers.

Capability: Reviews missing, assumed, nonlinear and IP-boundary data warnings, reports which block solve or rule checks, feeds the issue count, and exports a JSON blocking review.
Notes: Export packet embeds hard-coded governance identifiers.

Capability: Lets the user run or cancel the mechanics solve, choose dense or sparse solver mode, see a readiness and status summary, and export the solve job audit.
Tracks the solve job audit through start, backend polling, cancel, complete and failure, invalidates stale solves on model change, and reports solve-proof status only when all bases match.
Notes: No dedicated unit tests for the audit transitions.

Capability: Records the aggregate user rule-check status against the currently rendered model, result and input manifest, discarding stale aggregates.
Notes: Rule-check panel itself lives outside this area.

Capability: Results panel with text and family filters, paging, result detail, endpoint-pair tables, governing ratio state and source unit policy.
Binds each mechanics result row to its semantic family, dimension and category from a result semantic contract, rejecting a row whose unit contradicts its kind.
Notes: Reads projects/chirality-piping/fixtures/results/semantic_contract_v0_2.json; also used by export, handoff and report code.

Capability: Shows a mechanics gap ledger listing preview mechanics capabilities with implemented or deferred status and review notes.
Notes: Static hard-coded list, not derived from the solver.

Capability: Resolves a selected result or diagnostic to its model entity and interprets diagnostics so the user can jump from findings to entities.
Notes: Diagnostic interpretation is rendered by a panel outside this area.

Capability: On project open, verifies saved run evidence (run and model refs, model, envelope, result and analysis hashes, legacy preimages) and lists findings without restoring a current solve basis.
Notes: Always flags the missing historical input manifest.

Capability: Displays a reopened saved run as historical evidence with its findings and read-only results, stating it cannot drive current overlays, checks or reports.
Builds a redaction-controlled report package request from the session and saves it through the report package service.
Notes: Report builders live outside this area.

Capability: Routes toolkit capability commands and viewport creation-tool arming from the current selection, including history commands and inspector collapse during routing.
Notes: Capability catalog lives outside this area.

Capability: Loads a sample agent proposal for the selected review target into the session.
Notes: Uses a sample proposal loader, not a live agent.
